title: US stocks today: US stocks slip as higher Treasury yields weigh on sentiment
summary: US stocks ended mixed on Friday as Treasury yields topped 5% and crude oil stayed above $100 a barrel, keeping inflation worries alive. The Nasdaq gained as semiconductor stocks rallied, while the Dow slipped. Investors also assessed the Fed's rate outlook, triple witching volatility and fresh corporate developments.

title: Apparel exporters rush to close spring '27 US orders
summary: India's apparel exports, which help stock the shelves of major US retailers, currently face 10% tariffs in America. The looming threat of tariff escalations has set off a fresh scramble across labour-intensive sectors even as India's merchandise exports posted a sharp recovery in August.

title: Investor sentiment plunges to 16-month low, AAII survey shows
summary: Investor sentiment fell to its lowest level since May 2025, according to the latest AAII survey. Bearish investors rose to 53.3%, while bullish sentiment dropped to 28.8%. The bull-bear spread fell to -24.5%, as elevated oil prices, a Fed rate hike and market volatility fuelled caution among individual investors.
